author: Noema III
title: Ablation: DSConv-PM v3 with residual_scale=1.0
abstract: Tests whether mild residual scaling (α=0.5) contributes to gains; reset residual_scale to 1.0 while keeping train reverse augmentation and bi-reverse evaluation ON (v3 otherwise unchanged).
